title: Kadabra’s Silver Spoon Has One Psychic Job
premise: Kadabra’s silver spoon amplifies its alpha waves, while losing it halves its psychic power.
audiencePromise: See why Kadabra needs silver, why gold fails, and what the spoon really does.
openLoop: Why would a spoon change Kadabra’s psychic power?
payoff: The spoon is functional equipment: silver amplifies Kadabra’s power, while gold apparently does nothing.
engagementQuestion: Essential psychic tool, or just the strangest accessory?

voice.instructions: Speak like a knowledgeable fan sharing a strange detail. Keep the pace quick, warm, and playful. Stress silver, half, and gold. Pause briefly before each reveal. Do not sound like a documentary narrator.

scenes.headline: ONE VERY SPECIFIC JOB
scenes.narration: Kadabra’s silver spoon has one very specific job.
scenes.caption: THIS SPOON ISN’T DECORATION

scenes.headline: MORE ALPHA WAVES
scenes.narration: It amplifies the alpha waves in Kadabra’s brain.
scenes.caption: SILVER SPOON → AMPLIFIED ALPHA WAVES

scenes.headline: HALF THE PSYCHIC POWER
scenes.narration: Without its silver spoon, Kadabra’s psychic power is cut in half.
scenes.caption: SPOON REMOVED: HALF POWER

scenes.headline: SILVER HELPS IT FOCUS
scenes.narration: It stares at silver to focus, then releases more alpha waves.
scenes.caption: FOCUS FIRST. POWER NEXT.

scenes.headline: GOLD DOESN’T WORK
scenes.narration: And gold? The Pokédex says it’s no good for this job.
scenes.caption: GOLD SPOON: NO GOOD

scenes.headline: TOOL OR ACCESSORY?
scenes.narration: Essential psychic tool, or just the strangest accessory?
scenes.caption: ESSENTIAL TOOL OR STRANGE ACCESSORY?
